title: Upgrade, Migration und Pflege für INSPIRATION 2024-2027
description: Das Land Hessen setzt derzeit im Verfahren Geodaten online die Software INSPIRATION ein. Das Verfahren wird von der Hessischen Zentrale für Datenverarbeitung (HZD) im Auftrag der Hessisches Landesamt für Bodenmanagement und Geoinformation (HLBG) betrieben. Zur Erhaltung der Betriebssicherheit der aktuell im Verfahren Geodaten online eingesetzten Software INSPIRATION über den 31.12.2024 hinaus muss bis zum 31.12.2025 ein Upgrade von INSPIRATION vorgenommen werden, damit aktuelle Versionen der benötigten Standardsoftware (Betriebssysteme, Datenbanken, Shopsystem, GIS, Open Source) von INSPIRATION ab dem 01.01.2026 unterstützt werden. Zur Unterstützung der vorgenannten Standardsoftware durch INSPIRATION sind bis zum 31.12.2027 ein Upgrade bzw. weitere Migration vorzunehmen und entsprechende Upgrades der Standardsoftware durchzuführen und entsprechende Anpassungen am Quellcode von INSPIRATION vorzunehmen. Dies beinhaltet auch Anpassungen am Quellecode von INSPIRATION sowie den Austausch der Shop-Komponente, da der Herstellersupport für das derzeit in INSPIRATION eingesetzte Shopsystem Intershop ICM am 30.11.2026 endet. Für den Zeitraum 01.01.2026 bis 31.12.2027 sind für die Software INSPIRATION und von dieser benötigte Standardsoftware (mit Ausnahme der Betriebssysteme und der Datenbanksoftware Oracle) Pflegeleistungen zu erbringen. Diese Pflegeleistungen müssen von einem Leistungserbringer erbracht werden, um als Gesamtheit die Betriebssicherheit im Verfahren Geodaten online sicherzustellen. Für den Zeitraum der Pflegeleistungen 01.01.2026 bis 31.12.2029 sind zudem optionale Pflegeleistungen nach Aufwand für INSPIRATION und für die für INSPIRATION benötigte Standardsoftware zu erbringen. Es handelt sich hierbei um funktionale Erweiterungen von INSPIRATION.

title: Lake Saimaa 2.0 PR activities in USA and UK
description: Lake Saimaa 2.0 project introduction The objective of the Lake Saimaa 2.0 project is to elevate Saimaa as a significant international year-round destination for sustainable tourism, to foster growth in direct and indirect tourism revenue by promoting the region's international recognition, the readiness of local entrepreneurs for global markets, and collaborative networks. Additionally, the project advances local businesses' capabilities to identify new business opportunities and models, develop customer-oriented products, services, and joint offerings, and enhance sales particularly in international markets. Mikkeli Development Company Miksei Oy is responsible for exploring and opening new markets, improving companies' readiness for internationalization, product development, and marketing, and supporting sales efforts in so-called new markets (primarily the USA, France, Spain, and the UK). Furthermore, MikseiMikkeli is tasked with increasing the region's awareness and executing media and PR work. Lake Saimaa Region introduction Lake Saimaa region is Finland's largest lake region. Saimaa’s countryside is famous for its beautiful sparkling lakes, boundless green forests and vast archipelago. With thousands of miles of shoreline, charming lakeside resorts, manor houses, villas and saunas, interesting history and a great gastronomy and a variety of activities, Lake Saimaa’s preserved natural beauty makes it a stunning destination adored by both the locals and visitors. The objective of the tender The primary goals of the tender: - To identify and contract a PR agency capable of delivering strategic communications that amplify Lake Saimaa’s presence and appeal in both the US and UK markets during the designated period. - The agency will be expected to develop and implement comprehensive PR campaigns, employing innovative approaches and local market expertise to position Lake Saimaa as a must-visit destination for discerning travelers. - The scope of work includes designing integrated media strategies, cultivating high-value partnerships, and creating impactful storytelling that distinguishes Lake Saimaa from competitors. The primary goal of the PR project: To maximize Lake Saimaa and the region's main tourism service providers visibility in media in USA and UK, to enhance the awareness of Lake Saimaa and it's higlights, and to boost the visitor numbers from USA and UK in 2026. The expected activities The selected agency should be able to: • Enhance Brand Awareness: Establish and elevate the Lake Saimaa 2.0 brand among target audiences in both the US and UK, leveraging culturally relevant narratives and strategic media placements. • Secure High-Quality Media Coverage: Achieve prominent coverage across reputable media outlets, both traditional and digital, in travel and lifestyle segments. • Foster Influencer and Stakeholder Engagement: Build relationships with key journalists, travel influencers, and industry stakeholders to generate authentic interest and advocacy for Lake Saimaa. • Drive Targeted Messaging: Ensure that all communications are tailored to resonate with the unique preferences, trends, and values of US and UK audiences, while maintaining consistent brand messaging. • Measure and Optimize Campaign Performance: Provide transparent reporting on KPIs such as earned media value, share of voice, engagement rates, and resulting inquiries or bookings, and refine tactics accordingly. • Support Event and Partnership Initiatives: Conceptualize and execute strategic events, collaborations, and partnerships that showcase Lake Saimaa’s offerings and generate tangible buzz in both markets. • Navigate Market Nuances: Demonstrate in-depth understanding of local market dynamics, regulatory requirements, and media landscapes to ensure compliance and optimal campaign effectiveness. Requirements of the selected agency - The agency must be able to propose activities in both USA and UK within the stated budget. - In addition to the core activities listed, the agency must demonstrate a proactive approach in identifying emerging trends and opportunities within the travel and lifestyle sectors, adapting strategies to remain ahead of the curve. - Expertise in digital storytelling, social media amplification, and cross-market collaboration will be essential for driving sustained engagement and visibility. - The ability to present innovative ideas—grounded in data and tailored to Lake Saimaa’s brand personality—will be key in differentiating the destination amid a competitive international landscape. - Agencies with proven international experience, creative vision, and the operational capacity and senior level experience to deliver measurable results for Lake Saimaa 2.0 in both the US and UK will be prioritized in the selection process. Procurement procedure and budget for tender The procurement will be executed as a reverse tendering process with a fixed service price. The evaluation of tenders will be based on qualitative factors. Maximum monthly retainer budget TOTAL is 4500 EUR per month for a 4-month project for both USA and UK activities. Total budget for 4 months is 18 000 EUR. With option to extend the contract with Saimaa Horizon project budget. Questions related to the tender must be submitted via Cloudia platform by October 3rd, 2025. The tender must be submitted via Cloudia platform by October 10th, 2025. Expected project timeline October 15th,2025 – February 15th, 2026 or November 1st, 2025 – February 28th, 2026 Value of the contract Value of the contract does not exceed national treshold of 60 000,00 € (low-value procurement). National procurement notice form has been selected for technicality reasons (visibility and transparency). The request for tender is subject to approval of amendment application of Lake Saimaa 2.0 project. All offers for this request for tenderers must be submitted in English. title: QUALIFICATION  PERFORMANCE ENHANCEMENT OF EUROPEAN SPACE ADHESIVES FOR STRUCTURAL AND OPTICAL BONDING - EXPRO PLUS
description: Objectives:To qualify a European space adhesive, focused on structural and/or optical bonding applications, andcapable to withstand ground, launch and space environment effects.Description:Europe lacks a fully qualified space-ready adhesive for structural and optical bonding, despite the criticalrole these materials play in ensuring mission integrity across thermal, mechanical, and vacuumenvironments. Current ESA missions depend on long-established non-European systems whoseformulations and supply conditions are outside European control, creating operational and industrial risks for long-term use. Furthermore, ESA's industrial partners rely onthe extensive past heritage andvalidation of these non-European solutions, and adapting a European solution would require having dataavailable so that it can be done with confidence. This activity focuses also on validating and qualifyingexisting European adhesive candidates to demonstrate their suitability for space-relevant bonding processes. Rather than developing new formulations, the goal is to rigorously benchmark available European products, perform the necessary environmental and mechanical testing, and generatea complete qualification dataset. This will enable large system integrators and subcontractors to adopt EU-sourced adhesives with confidence, strengthening European autonomy and ensuring dependable access to mission-critical bonding materials.This activity encompasses the following tasks:- Review of available European adhesive formulators manufacturers and products with structural andglass-to-metal applications (focused on epoxies and potentially UV-curing adhesives, but otheralternatives are possible),- Review the TRL status, the performances already available and the manufacturing capabilities andidentify the gaps with respect to non-Europeanadhesives commonly used in space- Down select three with the largest potential with a focus on applicability. Characterize, if notavailable, asminimum E/G modulus in wide range of temperatures, CTE, thermal vacuum stability and outgassingperformance- Performadequate testing to verify the suitability of the adhesive/substrate solutions to the requiredenvironments. This includes space-application thermal response (at least thermal vacuum, mechanicalloads, adhesion strength) and dimensional stability tests (permanentpolymerisation shrinkage). It shouldalso include the main common substrates for these applications.- Apply and verify the use of the adhesive in the most common space-relevant adhesive bondingprocesses.The expected outcome is an increased TRL for European adhesives, supported by a comprehensive gap analysis of their properties, and the generation of robust performance data to make them available to theEuropean industry. The ultimate objective is to have qualified-European produced adhesives available toall space system integrators categories and subcontractors, facilitating a transition from non-European to fully European space adhesives.Deliverables: Technical report, Samples of developed adhesivesApplication/Need Date: All Missions Mission Classification: alpha, beta, gamma,delta.

Elles sont susceptibles de varier de la manière suivante : Pour l'ensemble des lots : sans montant minimum Lot 1 Fourniture d'équipements de protection individuelle : 25 000 Euros - montant maximum annuel HT Lot 2 Fourniture de vêtements de travail des personnels de la ville : 35 000 Euros - montant maximum annuel HT Lot 3 Fourniture de vêtements de travail de la police municipale : 22 000 Euros - montant maximum annuel HT Lot 4 Fourniture d'équipements divers et EPI de la police municipale : 22 800 Euros - montant maximum annuel HT Lot 5 Fourniture de vêtements techniques pour le service des sports : 10 000 Euros - montant maximum annuel HT | Lot 1 Fourniture d'équipements de protection individuelle | Il s'agit notamment de la fourniture de casques, bottes, chaussures de travail, sabots de sécurité, gants de manutention, baudriers, masques… | Lot 2 Fourniture de vêtements de travail des personnels de la ville | Il s'agit notamment de la fourniture de blousons, vestes, polaires, sweats… | Lot 3 Fourniture de vêtements de travail de la police municipale | Il s'agit notamment de la fourniture de blousons, bonnets, manchons, chaussures d'intervention … | Lot 4 Fourniture d'équipements divers et EPI de la police municipale | Il s'agit notamment de fourniture d'aérosols de défense, d'étui de cuisse, porte bâton télescopique, gilets pare-balles… | Lot 5 Fourniture de vêtements techniques de sport | Il s'agit notamment de fourniture de vêtements pour la pratique des sports terrestres y compris l'escalade et des sports nautiques : kayak - paddle.
